authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. The current Planning Data Local Planning Authority dataset contains administrative boundaries for LPAs in England and can identify the LPA responsible for an area. Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA reference/name, LAD identifier/name, organisation code, local-plan/local-plan-boundary reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore none of the LPA boundary records can be bound to this slot without guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
